description: This file defines the interface for the Host class within a device settings module, including its methods, associated classes, and listeners for power and display connection events.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: Class to implement the Host interface, managing power modes, sleep modes, connected devices, and event listeners.

methods.name: bool setPowerMode(int mode)
methods.description: Sets the device power mode.

methods.description: Retrieves the current power mode.

methods.description: Returns the preferred sleep mode.

methods.description: Sets the preferred sleep mode.

methods.description: Provides a list of available sleep modes.

methods.name: addDisplayConnectionListener

methods.name: removeDisplayConnectionListener
